job.title: Head of Commercial
job.description:
Head of Commercial (Insights driven)


Greater Manchester · Circa £75,000-£80,000 + benefits


A growing consumer business is looking for a Commercial leader to own the numbers behind the business and work closely with senior leadership.

This is a hands-on role. You'll continue building out a commercial reporting function that departments across the business rely on, work daily with operations, sales and logistics to keep performance data accurate, and be the person who can explain why the numbers move. You'll sit close enough to the detail to catch a problem in a product line or a channel before it reaches the monthly numbers, and close enough to leadership to turn that insight into a decision.


What you'll own:

  • Commercial and management reporting: the dashboards and models leadership quotes back in meetings, covering sales performance, margin and cost.
  • Performance tracking across departments, working directly with operations, sales and logistics teams to keep the data current and catch issues early.
  • Margin and cost analysis that feeds into pricing decisions, supplier negotiations and stock planning.
  • Forecasting and scenario modelling, giving leadership a realistic view of where the business is heading, built on current trading and channel trends.
  • Contract and supplier commercial reviews, working with procurement and operations to protect margin on renewals and new agreements.
  • Stock and demand planning input, working with logistics to flag where inventory decisions are affecting cash or service levels.
  • Sales performance analysis by channel, product and customer, working with the sales team to understand what's driving movement in the numbers.
  • A close working relationship with senior leadership, sitting in on decisions and challenging a number or a plan when the data tells a different story.


What we're looking for:

  • Solid commercial or FP&A experience in a fast-moving, growing business.
  • A track record of building reporting that departments actually use and trust.
  • An eye for where the numbers don't add up, and the instinct to know which variance is noise and which needs a phone call.
  • Comfortable working across functions: finance, operations, sales and logistics all feed into this role.
  • Confident with data and modern reporting tools, and quick to pick up whatever system the business runs on.
  • A self-starter who works closely with leadership without waiting to be asked.


Circa £75,000-£80,000, plus benefits.

Office based in Greater Manchester.

job.title: Head of Customer Insights and Analytics
job.description:
Customer Insight Lead


Social housing | Hybrid, Liverpool | £60,000


Turn data that is rich but siloed into something the whole business can make decisions on.


The organisation holds plenty of rich information on its service users: contact reasons, complaints, repairs history, satisfaction survey results, digital journeys. It sits in separate places and rarely gets used together. This role brings it into one picture and puts it in front of the people making decisions, across the customer function and the wider business.


What you'll do

  • Bring together what the organisation holds on service users across every channel, digital and otherwise, and turn it into evidence decision makers can use
  • Break down the gaps between data sources, so contact, complaints, repairs and survey data get read as one picture rather than several
  • Work across the customer function and the wider business: finance, operations, and the board, not just the team that owns customer experience
  • Sit on the new residents committee, bringing evidence into a forum where tenants have a direct say in the decisions that affect them
  • Keep pace with the regulatory environment shaping the sector and translate what it means for the numbers you own
  • Build the case for a decision on evidence rather than instinct, and hold that line in rooms where the instinct is strong


Our ideal applicant

  • Objective. You follow the data to its conclusion even when it is inconvenient
  • Commercially minded, able to connect service user data to decisions with a cost or a return attached, not only to satisfaction scores
  • Has broken down data silos before, and knows what it takes to get different systems and teams working from the same picture
  • Understands the regulatory pressures shaping social housing today, and what they mean operationally, not just for compliance reporting
  • Comfortable holding data from several sources at once: digital platforms, phone contact, home visits, complaints, surveys
  • An individual contributor by choice, confident presenting findings to people well outside the customer function, including residents themselves


The package

  • £60,000 base salary
  • Hybrid, based in Liverpool a few days a week
  • Benefits detail shared on application

﻿

All applications are handled confidentially by Stellify.

job.title: Senior Customer Service Manager
job.description:
Senior Manager, Service and Experience


East Midlands, 3 to 4 days on site | c.£75,000


Lead service and customer experience for a technology-led service business, running a 35 seat operation that serves business accounts and individual consumers.


The operation is small enough to move quickly and busy enough that nothing sits still. Demand shifts week to week, business customers and consumers want different things from the same team, and the technology behind the service is moving faster than the processes built around it. This role owns how customers experience all of it, and where that experience goes next.


What you'll own

  • The experience strategy: where service goes over the next 2 years and the decisions that get it there
  • Experience projects end to end: diagnosing the journey, redesigning it, delivering the change, and proving what it did for customers and for the numbers
  • The commercial performance of the function: cost to serve, retention, and the case for every investment you ask for
  • Technology and data: the platforms the team works in, what the data is saying, and what changes as a result
  • Service standards across contracted business accounts and consumer customers, with the tension between the two handled well
  • A 35 seat operation: team leaders, structure and capability


You'll be the voice of the customer at senior level, working closely with commercial, technology and operations, and trusted to make the calls when demand, priorities and systems are all moving at once.


Our ideal applicant

  • A service leader: currently leading a customer service or experience operation in a mid-sized business, with both business and consumer customers
  • Has run experience projects from diagnosis through to delivery and can show the results
  • Commercially minded: reads a P&L, understands cost to serve, and knows what good service is worth to the business
  • Works in an agile way in the practical sense: tests, learns, changes course when the evidence says so
  • At home in a service environment where the technology is central to the product
  • As comfortable building the roadmap as sitting with the team listening to calls


The package

  • c.£75,000 base salary
  • 3 to 4 days on site in East Midlands, with flexibility around the rest
  • Great corporate benefits


All applications are handled confidentially by Stellify

job.title: Recruitment Consultant
job.description:
Recruiter Liverpool, Royal Albert Dock. £28,000 to £32,000 plus commission, with full training.


We Are Stellify is one of the fastest growing recruitment businesses in Liverpool. We place the people who run and transform customer functions, and the name is already known to chief executives and customer leaders around the UK.


We're growing fast, and we're looking for a Recruitment Consultant to be part of it.

Joining a scale up means joining something still being built. It changes month to month, it invests where it's growing, and for an ambitious salesperson there's no better place to get good quickly.


The desk supports SaaS tech businesses on the hires that keep their customers engaged. Clients are UK wide and the market is busy. You'll place leadership roles across Customer Experience, Helpdesk, Account Management and Customer Success.


You'll work directly with our founder, 15 years in this industry and a top performer for most of them. The training behind this role is what makes it a fast track. You'll be in client conversations early, and you'll learn how to work with a client to build a role that has real impact. You'll get to know the talent in a market that keeps growing, and the depth of that insight is what sets you apart.


Apply if you want to be good at this quickly, and you like the idea of the business growing around you while you do it.


What we're looking for

Hard working. Tech savvy. Outgoing. Someone who sells a solution rather than reads a script.

Recruitment or sales experience helps. Neither is required. We'll teach you the tips and the tricks. What we can't teach is a natural ability to build a relationship and keep it.


What you get

Full training from someone who has done this at the top level. £28,000 to £32,000, plus commission. 30 days holiday including bank holidays. Health cash plan from your first day. High quality kit and some of the best AI powered technology in the market. Quarterly lunch clubs and a proper social calendar. Discounted parking at the Dock.


Office based at the Royal Albert Dock, with flexibility around home working and client meetings. The first year of this job is learned by overhearing it, which is why we want you in the office.

job.title: Customer Support & Insights Manager
job.description:
Customer Insight and Performance Manager


Liverpool (office based) | £40,000 to £44,000 including car allowance


Own performance, insight and regulatory compliance for a small, regulated property business where reporting goes all the way to Board. This role is the organisation's eyes: what's working, what's at risk, and what the data says should change.


The remit is broad for the size of business, and that's the appeal. You'll build the performance framework rather than inherit one, and your reporting will sit in front of Board and leadership every cycle.


What you'll own

  • The performance and insight framework: designing it, running it, and making it the way the business understands itself
  • Regulatory compliance and assurance: monitoring statutory and regulatory requirements, coordinating reporting for regulatory returns, internal reviews and external audits
  • Board reporting: papers, dashboards and exception reports that hold up to scrutiny
  • Customer complaints and feedback analysis, turned into recommendations that change how services run
  • Contractor and partner performance: KPIs, SLAs, and the meetings where accountability actually happens
  • Business systems and data improvement: better data quality, simpler workflows, and supporting new systems from testing through to training
  • Line management of a Compliance Officer, plus mentoring apprentices


Our ideal applicant

  • A customer-led performance leader: uses insight, complaints and service data to improve customers' experience, and can show where it worked
  • Strong on statutory and regulatory compliance, and confident being the person the organisation relies on to stay ahead of it
  • Skilled at data interrogation and analysis, and clearer still at explaining what the numbers mean to a Board
  • Comfortable challenging contractors and partners while keeping the relationship working


The package

  • £40,000 to £45,000, including car allowance
  • 35 hours, Monday to Friday, with flexi time
  • Office based in Liverpool
  • Pension with employer contribution
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays


All applications are handled confidentially by Stellify.
